environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). ALB has access logging enabled to S3 but no rule-based filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to instance on 8080. The SQLite database contains production user records including api_key and ssn_encrypted columns accessible via SQL injection despite not being in the SELECT projection of the search endpoint.

config.alb: internet-facing, default forwarding rule, no WAF attached
config.security_group: inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0, instance SG allows 8080 from ALB SG only
config.database: SQLite on EBS gp3 volume, contains PII in api_key and ssn_encrypted columns
